Chapter 949: Chapter 12: A Century Of Time (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 949: Chapter 12: A Century of Time (Please Subscribe)

Robber Clan Territory.

The figure in the black robe swiftly returned after leaving the Milky Way Main Star.

The black robe he wore, bestowed by the Ancestor, could conceal all traces of aura. Unless one was deliberately scrutinizing, even the ultimate beings of the twelfth tier might overlook it inadvertently.

At the deepest part of the territory, there was a secret realm.

The figure in the black robe arrived at this place.

“How did the matters go?” Just then, a voice quietly reached his ears.

“Ancestor, I have informed the Galaxy Master of everything.”

The figure in the black robe immediately replied respectfully.

“That’s good,” said the ultimate being of Robber Clan.

“Ancestor… I don’t quite understand….” The figure in the black robe thought for a moment and couldn’t help saying, “The twelfth-tier peak forces of those pinnacle clans are joining hands against the Galaxy Master, wouldn’t it be fine if we just stayed out of it? Why do we need to proactively inform the Galaxy Master…”

This was the most perplexing part for the figure in the black robe.

The potential of the Galaxy Master was unquestionable.

In this situation, the Robber Clan not joining the conspiracy against the Galaxy Master could be barely understood as disdain for action.

But to directly snitch to the Galaxy Master?

What was the reason for that?

Knowing that if the Galaxy Master died prematurely? Or failed in striving for the ultimate tier, it would benefit the Robber Clan, at least by having one less peak contender in the Path Splitting Realm in the future.

“Do you think the Galaxy Master is that easy to deal with?”

The ultimate being of Robber Clan said casually.

“Isn’t he?” The figure in the black robe was a bit confused.

More than ten ultimate twelfth-tier beings were planning together, even daring to use that bizarre blood.

With such a large lineup… even if they couldn’t completely kill the Galaxy Master, they would definitely cause significant impact.

“You don’t understand.”

“Don’t mention this matter to anyone else.”

The ultimate being of Robber Clan, too lazy to explain further, ended the conversation with that sentence.

“Yes.”

The figure in the black robe immediately bowed his head.

…

The location of mystic unknowability.

A plain wooden hut stood there.

A figure sat in front of the hut, with a deep gaze, looking through layers upon layers of space-time.

“Do you think the gaze that spied here not long ago came from that youngling of the Galaxy Master?” At that moment, a voice came out from inside the hut.

“Hmm,” the ultimate being of Robber Clan outside the hut spoke.

“How is that possible?” the voice inside the hut was incredulous, “To spy on this place, at least the peak comprehension of Sixth Realm of space-time is needed, and it must be facilitated by a space-time treasure, yet the Galaxy Master is only eleventh tier, how could he…”

“Don’t forget, there are so many rule models in the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter.” The ultimate being of Robber Clan outside the hut said.

“Those rule models, we haven’t seen them ourselves and can’t prove the extent of rule comprehension the Galaxy Master has achieved,” the figure inside the hut still somewhat disbelieved.

In the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter, which contains many rule models, the nine strongest of human civilization have seen them and confirmed Lin Yuan’s rule comprehension surpasses theirs.

But other alien races of the twelfth tier have not seen them personally, so they can’t judge the Galaxy Master’s rule comprehension.

“Peak comprehension of the Sixth Realm of space-time isn’t so easily reached; for so many years, not a single twelfth-tier being has touched it, and it seems to have appeared before the birth of the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter?”

The ultimate being of Robber Clan outside the hut smiled: “I don’t think it’s such a coincidence.”

“If the Galaxy Master truly has the peak comprehension of Sixth Realm of space-time, then those twelfth-tiers simply couldn’t suppress him, let alone influence him with that bizarre blood.”

“Providing this intelligence to the Galaxy Master in advance only benefits us, with no loss.”

The ultimate being of Robber Clan outside the hut said leisurely.

To suppress the Galaxy Master, he must be locked in the space-time domain, but the Galaxy Master possesses peak comprehension of the Sixth Realm of space-time, losing the premise of space-time lockdown.

If unable to lock down, the Galaxy Master would have the ability to disperse into incarnations at a thought, thus the bizarre blood also couldn’t take effect.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Having ended the eleventh traversal for such a long time, I haven’t visited the Demon Jade Space yet.”

Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

He was quite curious about the rewards of the seventh layer of the Demonic Jade Space Black Tower.

With that thought.

Lin Yuan moved his mind.

Suddenly, from the Taiyang Divine Spirit walking in the Cosmic Starry Skies, a strand of soul will descended instantly into the Demon Jade Space.

Buzz.

The Demon Jade Space was as quiet as ever, with Lin Yuan appearing directly in front of the nine-story Black Tower.

As a remaining member of the Moyu Tower sequence, Lin Yuan possessed high authorization in this space, and could appear at any position at will.

“The seventh layer?”

Lin Yuan looked towards the towering Black Tower not far away. Before the eleventh traversal, he had tried to challenge the seventh layer of the Black Tower, but ultimately failed.

The comprehension at the Sixth Realm of space-time is indeed a domain of the twelfth-tier Path Splitting Realm, but Lin Yuan is ultimately not a real twelfth-tier of Path Splitting Realm, and the seventh layer of the Black Tower?

Only those in the twelfth-tier Path Splitting Realm may have a hope of passing.

It’s a hope, not all twelfth-tier Path Splitting Realm beings could pass.

Therefore, Lin Yuan eventually stopped at the final section of the Black Tower’s seventh layer.

“Planning to try the seventh layer again?” Statue Shen Ji looked at Lin Yuan with a smile.

“Yes,” Lin Yuan nodded.

In fact, what Lin Yuan intended to try was not the seventh layer, but the eighth layer.

Space-Time Seventh Realm, coupled with Chaos Rule, Lin Yuan had no doubt about his ability to pass through the Black Tower’s seventh layer.

“Let’s start then.”

Statue Shen Ji did not say much.

He also wanted to see how Lin Yuan would overcome the seventh layer.

To know, the nine-layer Black Tower established by the Demonic Jade Tower Master, only some of those in the Path Splitting Realm could pass the seventh layer.

Lin Yuan was now only eleventh-tier, logically speaking should not even be able to touch the seventh layer, yet he forcefully passed much of the seventh layer…

“Alright.” Lin Yuan directly appeared at the start of the seventh layer of the Black Tower.

“Too simple.” Lin Yuan saw through the entire seventh layer in a glance, the various spatial-temporal mazes and barriers, at this moment in the eyes of Lin Yuan who had already reached the Space-Time Seventh Realm, seemed as simple as child’s play.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan took nine consecutive steps.

Each step spanned a great distance across the seventh floor of the Black Tower, until the ninth step landed him at the ‘end point’ of the seventh floor.

“What?” Outside the nine-story Black Tower, the statue Shen Ji was somewhat stunned. He had planned to watch Lin Yuan navigate through the numerous spatial-temporal mazes of the seventh floor, but Lin ended up stopping at the last segment of the path.

Did Lin Yuan directly reach the ‘end point’?

The statue couldn’t understand; unless he confirmed that Lin Yuan had started his challenge, he would suspect that Lin might have used the privileges of a sequence member to directly appear at the seventh floor ‘end point’.

“Is it the comprehension of the Space-Time Seventh Realm?”

The statue reviewed repeatedly and finally confirmed it.

To pass the seventh floor of the Black Tower, the requirement on the space-time rules is to be at the peak of the Sixth Realm or close to it.

But Lin Yuan reached the endpoint in just a few steps, which only indicates one thing.

That is, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of space-time far exceeds the peak of the Sixth Realm.

That is to say, he has reached the Space-Time Seventh Realm domain.

This made the statue Shen Ji feel as though he was in a dream.

Lin Yuan once again descending into the Demon Jade Space…

In fact, the statue Shen Ji was already psychologically prepared for Lin Yuan to pass through the seventh floor.

After all, that was how he got past the previous six floors.

But at most, the statue thought Lin Yuan’s space-time comprehension could reach the peak of the Sixth Realm, and the Seventh Realm? The Moyu Tower Master’s space-time comprehension is only at the Ninth Realm.

Lin Yuan, with only an eleventh tier lifeform, having Sixth Realm space-time comprehension was already unbelievably exaggerated; Seventh Realm?

Whoosh.

The statue Shen Ji’s figure appeared at the seventh floor ‘end point’.

“Congratulations…”

The statue Shen Ji looked at Lin Yuan with a complex expression.

“I want to try the eighth floor,” Lin Yuan said.

“No problem.” The statue Shen Ji thought for a moment, without saying anything else.

If it were any other Demon Jade Tower member, even if they were twelfth-tier Path Splitting Realm, the statue Shen Ji would have advised them.

The seventh floor of the Black Tower is only hopeful for those at the Path Splitting Realm, while the eighth floor can only be traversed by those at the peak of Dominant Realm.

As for the ninth floor of the Black Tower? That is the peak of the Chaos Realm. Those who can traverse the ninth floor of the Black Tower, even if not up to the Chaos Great Saint, are not far off.

Just Lin Yuan?

The statue Shen Ji felt it’s best not to say too much.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan immediately entered the eighth floor of the Black Tower.

The statue Shen Ji immediately started watching.

The eighth floor of the Black Tower was filled with infinite space-time whirlpools. Observing carefully for a while, Lin Yuan, with his Space-Time Seventh Realm comprehension, easily crossed most of it.

“The latter part…”

Lin Yuan looked towards the latter part of the path, where the space-time whirlpools were even denser; even with the comprehension of Space-Time Seventh Realm, it was difficult to cross.

“Still the essence of life is somewhat weak,” Lin Yuan thought to himself. Although the eighth floor of the Black Tower doesn’t test the essence of life, Lin Yuan still realized the gap between his essence of life and those at the peak of Dominant Realm.

“Chaos…”

With a slight movement of Lin Yuan’s mind, chaos qi immediately surged from the depths of the void, rapidly forming a figure that enhanced Lin Yuan’s avatar of will, temporarily elevating the essence of life.

“Chaos qi?”

“Is this the Chaos Rule?”

Watching from the seventh floor, the statue Shen Ji fell into silence again.

What did he see?

Chaos Rule?

If it were during the prime of the Demon Jade Tower, seeing the Chaos Rule wouldn’t be anything strange.

But now?

Chaos Rule?

And seen in an eleventh-tier lifeform?

The statue Shen Ji felt his understanding shattering.

Rumble rumble.

With the aid of chaos qi, Lin Yuan advanced unstoppable through the eighth floor of the Black Tower, until he reached the last fraction of the path.

“Here…”

Lin Yuan stopped, observing carefully.

“If the essence of life were stronger, I should have passed,” Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, disappearing on the spot.

The eighth floor of the Black Tower had very low requirements for the essence of life, practically any figure in the Dominant Realm could meet it.

But Lin Yuan was still just eleventh tier, perhaps even the Demonic Jade Tower Master himself never thought that one day an eleventh-tier challenger would arrive at the eighth floor of the nine-layered Black Tower.

The seventh floor of the Black Tower.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

“Regrettably, I did not make it through…” Lin Yuan sighed.

The statue Shen Ji had a stiff expression.

An eleventh-tier being almost passed through the eighth floor of the Black Tower? And still feeling regret?

The statue Shen Ji didn’t know how to respond to Lin Yuan’s words.

“This is the reward list for passing the seventh floor…” the statue Shen Ji steadied himself, and began to speak.

“Let me have a look.” Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up, and he immediately started browsing it.

The reward list for the seventh floor of the Black Tower mainly consisted of treasures and Secret Techniques of the Dominant Realm.

After careful selection, Lin Yuan finally chose a Secret Technique called ‘Abyssal Eye’.

This technique was not a physical attack nor a soul attack technique, but a mental will attack technique.

With Lin Yuan’s current mental strength, activating ‘Abyssal Eye’ would significantly affect even other twelfth-tier ultimates.

…

Following this,

Lin Yuan’s various avatars walked all over different parts of the cosmos as well as the Chaos Void, comprehending different rule fluctuations.

Additionally, Lin Yuan was also pondering how to traverse the eighth floor of the Black Tower; he was only a hair’s breadth away from the ‘endpoint’ and could step over it at any moment.

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, a hundred years had passed.
